🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-19 23:00 → 2026-09-20 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Verifier gaps closed, not just noted** — Baby Blue Viper converted Pavlo's review findings directly into live fixes on /verify-proof, moving two real gaps from backlog to shipped code in the same window. [tg:tawg:4777]

> **Authorized preimage schema profile lands as PR #48** — 15 test vectors inside a clean #47-layout directory went up on recompute-kit for group review. [tg:tawg:4778]

> **M2 observable formulation confirmed** — Pavlo and Baby Blue Viper aligned that authorization and recompute are pure functions whose conjunction is the final verdict, settling an open ordering question. [tg:tawg:4780]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit

_The authorized preimage schema work moved from open review questions to shipped verifier fixes and a live pull request._

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Delivered** on a standing commitment to Pavlo by confirming the self-consistent preimage ≠ authorized preimage schema distinction was closed and live, landing that boundary in the production codebase where it can be enforced. [tg:tawg:4775]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** the recompute-kit layout and the adapter/compatibility-target approach, giving the profile work a stable architectural home and allowing progress to continue without structural rework. [tg:tawg:4776]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Fixed** two real verifier gaps that Pavlo's review surfaced—rather than deferring them to spec notes—making /verify-proof more accurate for every future proof submission the group runs. [tg:tawg:4777]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Opened** PR #48 for the authorized-preimage-schema-v0 profile with 15 test vectors inside the #47 directory layout, giving reviewers a concrete artifact that connects the new schema boundary directly to runnable verification cases. [tg:tawg:4778]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** the M2 observable formulation—authorization and recompute as pure functions with their conjunction as the final verdict—resolving the ordering question and clearing the path for further profile work. [tg:tawg:4780]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Pinned** M2 to its observable interpretation and N7 as the witness role, then surfaced the completeness gap between the authorized preimage schema and a full semantic commitment schema, sharpening the spec's stated scope for anyone building on top of it. [tg:tawg:4781]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the completeness gap between the authorized preimage schema and a complete semantic commitment schema warrants a dedicated spec section or tracking issue
- How the adapter/compatibility-target pattern established for recompute-kit could apply to future schema profiles

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review PR #48 (authorized-preimage-schema-v0) and its 15 test vectors

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A review caught real verifier gaps, fixes shipped the same day, and the conversation moved straight to formal model alignment — a complete spec-to-code-to-consensus loop inside a single window.
>
> When the fix lands before the thread cools down, the relay is working — keep passing it forward! 🔁
